text_block_list.text: Upon arriving at the training track—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, feeling great! The next race 
will definitely be another big victory for 
Lady Teio!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oho. With the race right before you, you 
are already confident in your victory?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, President! Of course! There's no way I 
could ever lose!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After all, my dream is to be the coolest 
Horse Girl who gets the most cheers in the 
whole world—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So there's no way I'd lose in a place like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pressing forward fearlessly—such ambition 
is a potent weapon. I am sure you will 
achieve a fine result in the next race as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. I got the President's seal of 
approval!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, do not forget about the Winning 
Live. It is an essential opportunity to 
express gratitude to your fans—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, the live! That totally slipped my 
mind!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta come see me dance at the 
center, okay, President?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Dancing on stage in a super cool racing 
outfit... Stealing everyone's gaze all for 
myself! I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, gotta run even more for that! 
See ya later, President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I meant to tell her not to neglect her 
dance lessons since it is such an 
important occasion, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good grief, Teio. What a restless child.

Symboli Rudolf seemed exasperated by Tokai 
Teio's uninhibited nature, yet quietly 
impressed.
